items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: my father was a band, an orchestra leader. He was the orchestra leader at the Grand Opera House

ctx.x: my father was a band, an orchestra leader. He was the orchestra leader at the Grand Opera House, which was a theater in Greenville, and he was the orchestra leader. And they used to have all kind of shows coming through there in those days. It was not an opera. Exactly as an opera, like La Tosca, or the great operas. It was, they had attractions of vaudeville, shows, road shows, and also minstrel shows, and things like that. What they used to refer to as burlesque opera, huh? Yeah. Yeah.
And Charles Hirsch, where was he from?
